<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_EvanstonianRoomService"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/evanstonian-room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RoomServiceCall" name="Room-service call"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Hotel" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestCall" name="Room-service call"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Guest" targetRef="Event_RoomServiceCall"
                      messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Order delivery"
                      sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Participant_Guest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InclusiveWorkSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPrepSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPrepJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InclusiveWorkJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitToBill</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_RoomServiceComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_RoomServiceCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RoomServiceCall"
                                  messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down the order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit" name="Start kitchen and manager work" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InclusiveWorkSplit" name="Start applicable preparation" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks" name="Fetch wine and prepare other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPrepSplit" name="Prepare cart and nonalcoholic drinks" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart with tablecloth and silverware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPrepJoin" name="Cart and nonalcoholic drinks ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InclusiveWorkJoin" name="Preparation complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin" name="Food and other preparation complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order to guest room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingDecision" name="Another order to prepare or deliver?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitToBill" name="Wait to bill until the other order is prepared or delivered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Continue to billing" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Debit guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_RoomServiceComplete" name="Account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Event_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_InclusiveWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_InclusiveWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${order.includesAlcoholicBeverage}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_InclusiveWorkSplit" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_InclusiveWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InclusiveWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_InclusiveWorkJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not hasAnotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingDecision" targetRef="Task_WaitToBill">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasAnotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_WaitToBill" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="Event_RoomServiceComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
